name: Psoriasis
description: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune condition that affects the skin, causing it to become thickened and scaly. It is characterized by red patches covered with silvery scales.
symptoms: Red, raised, and often scaly patches on the skin
Thickened skin around nails (pitting or lifting)
ingredients_to_avoid: Irritating ingredients like alcohol and fragrances

daily_routine.step: Apply moisturizer regularly to maintain skin hydration.
Use a humidifier in dry climates or during winter months.
daily_routine.purpose: Prevents skin from becoming overly dry and irritated.

lifestyle_tips: Manage stress through techniques like meditation or yoga.
Avoid smoking and limit alcohol consumption.
common_myths: Psoriasis can be cured by sunburns (excessive UV exposure can worsen symptoms).
when_to_consult_doctor: If your condition worsens or if you develop new symptoms, consult a dermatologist.
prevention: Maintain a healthy lifestyle to reduce risk factors.

severity_levels.mild: Mild psoriasis may involve fewer than three affected areas with minimal scaling and no significant discomfort.
severity_levels.moderate: Moderate psoriasis involves more extensive skin involvement, affecting between 3-10% of the body surface area, causing noticeable symptoms but not severe impairment in daily activities.
severity_levels.severe: Severe psoriasis covers over 10% of the body and can cause significant physical discomfort, disability, and impact on quality of life.

expert_tips: Follow a consistent treatment plan as prescribed by your dermatologist.
Regularly communicate with your healthcare provider about changes in symptoms or side effects from medications.
